description: This file defines a command-line setup command for a Swift project, utilizing the Commander library. It allows writing a default configuration to a specified path, involving configuration loading and saving.

classes.name: SetupCommand
classes.description: A command-line command for setting up default configuration, conforming to ParsableCommand, handling configuration path option, and writing configuration asynchronously.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the setup command asynchronously, creates default configuration, saves it to the specified URL, and prints confirmation.
